Resolves #19975

Ports the two reliability fixes from `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1242` (`5606649179`) and `neomjs/neo-agent-institution#781` (`5606649464`) to `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml`: sets `concurrency.queue: max` so pending claim runs on the same issue queue in FIFO order instead of canceling earlier pending claims, and refreshes `issue` via `github.rest.issues.get` before calling `decideReply` so queued runs suppress replies when the issue was closed or decurated and consult current assignees when assigned while queued.

Evidence: L2 (YAML parse + controlled replay of embedded `github-script` callback across 7 scenarios; L2 required for `#19975` AC-1..AC-3; hosted GitHub Actions activation is post-merge observation).
agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `neo-agent-skills-pr-body` and `neo-agent-skills-ticket-archaeology` ran.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml:20-23` (`concurrency.queue: max` + 3-claimant `alice`/`bob`/`carol` FIFO burst replay) |
| AC-2 | `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml:48-58` (`github.rest.issues.get` refresh + `issue.state !== 'open' || !label` early suppression) |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI controlled callback replay across 3-claimant FIFO burst and 4 queued state-mutation cases (`closed-while-queued`, `decurated-while-queued`, `assigned-to-other-while-queued`, `assigned-to-claimant-while-queued`) |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
Executed the embedded `actions/github-script@v9` callback from `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` (`794252bc4f`) against `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs`:
- **3-claimant FIFO burst (`alice`, `bob`, `carol`):** `alice: first-in-line`, `bob: held-by-alice`, `carol: held-by-alice`.
- **4 queued state mutations:** `closed-while-queued` (`gets: 1, posted: null`), `decurated-while-queued` (`gets: 1, posted: null`), `assigned-to-other-while-queued` (`gets: 1, posted: 'already assigned to @maintainer-picked'`), `assigned-to-claimant-while-queued` (`gets: 1, posted: null`).

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] Post-merge observation: verify next live contributor claim on a curated `good first issue` / `help wanted` ticket in `neomjs/neo` triggers `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` with a fresh `issues.get` read and posts the reply comment.
